summary: A Yes vote enacts a City of Ontario transactions and use (sales) tax.

tax.text: A Yes vote would establish a half-cent sales tax to fund public safety, street repairs, homelessness programs, affordable housing, and other city services.
tax.quote: To maintain fire, paramedic, police, 911 response, anti-gang programs; respond to property crimes, thefts, burglaries; clean and maintain public areas; repair streets/potholes; address homelessness; increase access to affordable housing for seniors/families/individuals; retain/attract local businesses; for general City services; shall the measure establishing a half-cent sales tax providing approximately $32,500,000 annually until ended by voters; requiring audits, spending disclosure, funds locally controlled, be adopted?
